current_owner_additions.decision: Defaults are safe starting values, not permanent Owner laws unless an explicit safety/domain reason makes them non-configurable.
The Library Editor v1.2.17 executable blueprint is the only currently accepted executable design reference among the discussed surface blueprints; reuse its compatible mechanics directly.
current_owner_additions.supersedes: Any inference that latest Visualize/W03/other blueprint candidate is equally accepted.

current_owner_additions.decision: Visualize, W03 and other non-Library blueprints/candidates are value/proposal/evidence sources only until explicit future Owner/Controller design adjudication. Mine current Owner requests and useful mechanics; do not inherit the whole blueprint as authority.

The new foundation must maximize executable reusable structure across all 23 surfaces: global cores, surface-family engines and thin domain adapters. Never build a generic mechanic independently for one surface when it can be shared.
Accepted Library editor mechanics should become reusable executable editor/structured-content primitives so Learn and every compatible authoring surface can inherit them rather than reimplement them.

Visualize/spatial mechanics should be factored as a reusable spatial engine with domain adapters so Visualize and every compatible W03/other surface benefit from one implementation. Candidate Visualize/W03 designs may supply needs, but are not final design authority.
current_owner_additions.supersedes: Separate spatial input/layout engines per surface.

current_owner_additions.decision: Future Work must consume the canonical authority/supersession registry before raw candidates. Historical framework-specific target files, classes, routes and stack paths are not authority for the new foundation unless freshly adjudicated.
